title: Chapter 969
paragraphs: Chapter 969
240th Episode. Crisis of the Yekbong Tribe(2)
The 3rd city of the Yekbong Tribe, Patlok.
"Damn it! Gailla, our kin and Usrok have been devastated so miserably...!"
Rakiman Hog shouted.
While the 4th city, Usrok, was being attacked, it was natural that the highest level of emergency was declared in the rest of the cities of the Yekbong Tribe.
Every time communication was connected with Usrok, the news conveyed was desperate.

They heard the voices of their kin being massacred in magic and flames, and even the Warlord Gailla screamed in a voice that could not hide his confusion. Due to communication interference, they could not exactly understand what Gailla and other kin were saying.
However, it was clear that it was full of screams and death. And the only enemy displayed on the screens of the bracelets of the Yekbong commanders was one person, Elona Zipple.
Shimat stared at the screen floating on his bracelet with a somber face. The communication Gailla sent at the end was being repeated on the screen.
-"I thought you were consumed by the Holy Grail, but you resist more fiercely than I thought. Gailla Tun, this meaningless act only tires us both."
-"Urgh......Kuh!"
-"Well, you probably can't understand what I'm saying anyway."
Along with the voice, the blurred images showed fragmented scenes of the situation at that time.
Gailla attempted to attack Elona recklessly for a while. His heart of light was broken and he had lost his reason.

Such attacks could not threaten Elona. Elona spent time leisurely blocking Gailla's attacks. She didn't cut off Gailla's breath on purpose until the power of the Holy Grail completely consumed Gailla.

-"It's finally a little quiet. Hmm... Yes, you were originally trying to buy time for your subordinates to leave by using the transformation called Castle. And this castle was the aerial fortress that destroyed the 1st tower of the former Lislit Autonomous District, right?"
-"Kahak, Kahaak."
-"Oh, it seems you were short of blood to use the aerial fortress...... It will be a good spoil."
That was all the communication left on the bracelet. There were definitely more situations before and after, but the rest could not be recognized due to communication interference.

'Elona Zipple has the ability to interfere with communication and dimensional movement, just like the massive forces of the era before the seal... It's likely that she learned it during recent battles with the Devil's World. And this communication was probably transmitted when Elona Zipple was temporarily unable to control the communication interference perfectly while dealing with Gailla.'
Shimat focused more on the abilities shown by Elona than Gailla's end and the destruction of Usrok.
Witnessing the deaths of his kin was unbearably painful, but if they didn't respond right away, other kin would also end up that way.
"...Rakiman, we have to fight."
Rakiman's eyes widened.
"Shimat, what are you talking about? It was you who argued at the emergency meeting opened after the situation broke out that we should not send reinforcements to Usrok!"
"Rakiman looked as if he were ready to tear Shimat apart at any moment.
Shimat had just strongly opposed the other Battle Kings' opinion to support Usrok in the just-concluded communication meeting.

The Battle Kings believed that no matter how strong Elona was, it made no sense for one person who had come alone to the main base to be feared and remain still. They said that if the aerial fortresses moved at once, they could not only block Elona, but also possibly kill her.
However, Bakarun, the current highest authority of the enemy race, once again supported Shimat's opinion. As Shimat was suddenly saying they should fight again, Rakiman naturally wanted to kill him.

"Yes, I still think we should not fight against Elona. No, rather, after seeing the communication left by our Gailla brethren, I am more convinced. I don't know what happened in the Demon World, but the current Elona Zipple is stronger than we have ever understood. Moreover, she seems to have added a very powerful level of mental control ability."
"Ha! So what are you saying we should fight against?"
"The Royal Family. In my opinion, we, the enemy race, should lead all aerial fortresses and troops to attack the Royal Family right now."
"What...!? What nonsense are you talking about? Even our Gailla brethren couldn't operate the aerial fortress due to a lack of blood, and were attacked by Elona."
"By making our brethren below 2nd class Battle Kings into immortal armies, and adding the blood of the Blue people who are currently left in Patlok, we can immediately operate Patlok."
"This crazy bastard! Even when we were in the Grand Peak, we avoided doing such things as much as possible!"
In the end, Rakiman slapped Shimat in the face. However, Shimat continued his words without changing his expression at all.

"Also, the aerial fortress of the first city can also be operated in this way. By operating two aerial fortresses at once and immediately occupying the major bases of the Royal Family to secure the buried Blue people they have hidden, the remaining two can also be operated."
The ancient enemy race originally possessed a total of six aerial fortresses.

Five castles ruled by the Battle Kings and the special aerial fortress of the Battle God. However, the whereabouts of the Battle God's aerial fortress are currently unknown, and Gailla's Usrok was recently claimed by Zipple.
Shimat was sure that if things continued this way, the remaining aerial fortresses would all fall into the hands of Zipple or the Royal Family, and the enemy race would face annihilation.
"We need to reverse our relationship with the Royal Family using all four of your aerial fortresses. Afterwards, while Zipple is holding back Runcandel, we must somehow find the Battle God brothers."

"I'm speechless. Alright, let's assume we do as you say. But on what basis? On what basis do we turn our perfectly fine brethren into immortal armies, use up all the blood of the saved Blue people, and gamble like this? There's no confirmation that there are definitely buried Blue people in the main bases of the Royal Family."
"Huh, Brother Rakiman."
Shimat sighed and looked into Rakiman's eyes. At that moment, Rakiman felt strangely intimidated and nearly stepped back.
It felt like he was facing the angry eyes of the Battle God from the old days.

"You just have to choose whether to die slowly or take a gamble with hope. Do you think I want to make our brethren into immortal armies? We definitely decided to attack the Royal Family at a meeting right after Bakarun woke up and moved immediately, but the enemies are creating variables faster than us."

The Vamel Alliance has grown stronger with the return of the expeditionary force, and Zipple has not only woken up Elona but also made her stronger. Kelliark's sudden return and the change of family was also a disaster for the enemy race.
Kinzelo has not shown any significant changes after the conquest of the Demon World, but just the fact that the above forces are not touching it proves its strength.

On the other hand, the Red Race lost not only their entire army and fleet under Gaila and Whiha, but also their airborne fortress Usrok in the sudden attack. They even lost Usrok at a stage where they were preparing step by step to betray the royal family.

"Did you say there might not be any pure-blooded race in the main bases of the royal family? You're correct. But at that time, we can take the blood of the royal bastards itself. The only future lies in finding the whereabouts of the god by somehow suppressing the royal family. Is it easy for us to beat the royal family with our current power, or to defeat the Vamel Union, Zipple, and Kinzelo?"
Rakiman couldn't show any more anger.
Even if we discount the delusion of feeling the dignity of the god from Shimat, his opinion itself was not unreasonable.

"Perhaps Elona is already moving. An hour has passed since this communication arrived, and it wouldn't be strange if our castle, Patlock, is also in the same situation as Usrok right now. And this place is closest to Usrok."
"...Ha! Okay, Shimat. Let's contact Brother Bakarun for now."
A window appeared as a red light spread across Rakiman's bracelet.
{Brother Rakiman. Did you get another message from Usrok?}
"Brother Bakarun, Brother Shimat has something to say."
{Speak.}
Shimat calmly conveyed his opinion to Bakarun for a while.
Bakarun also showed an unpleasant expression when Shimat spoke about turning their brethren into an immortal army, but as soon as the story was over, he decided to accept Shimat's opinion.
{We should execute this immediately. Even the time for detailed discussion feels dangerous. Then, where did you decide for the initial invasion area?}

"Fireol and Maysil. When the royal family provided us with the blood of the pure-blooded race, most of the time they delivered it through Fireol. And according to the information I have collected separately until now... Maysil is likely the Emperor's residence."
Both Fireol and Maysil were ancient cities of small numbers.
Among them, Fireol was the area where Orgal met the Red Race and faced Manop and his miners.
At that time, all the miners were weapons completed based on the information left in Temar's body, and Orgal had not yet properly shared that information with Jin.
{Understood. Our first castle, Pibilok, will go to attack Maysil. The castle operation will take... approximately one hour.}
"As long as Elona Zipple doesn't attack Patlock inside, the first step is successful. Then, we will start preparing from now on."
Rakiman did not mind the two deciding things without involving himself, the owner of Patlock. The dignity he felt from Shimat was warning him that he shouldn't.
Except for strange and special cases like Shimat, the Red Race was a society where subordinates had to obey the commands of superiors.
There was no one who resisted becoming immortal sacrifices for the operation of Patlock. The Red Race was happy to give their blood and life and just shout.
"For the Red!"
"The red sky will return again!"
At the moment when the two airborne fortresses, Pibilok and Patlock, started to rise to the underground sky.
The royal family, still unaware of Elona's invasion, was just moving the pure-blooded race to Fireol to offer a carrot and stick to the Red Race.
